description: Machine-readable record of the two independent executions of Glioma_Grading_v4_EXECUTED.ipynb referenced in the manuscript (Section 5.10, Robustness Checks; Section 7, Limitations) and README.md Section 7.

dataset_verification.sha256_of_content: <computed at runtime by the notebook's Section 3 audit cell; identical across both runs below, confirming both environments analysed the byte-identical dataset>
dataset_verification.note: The hash itself is not reproduced here as a literal value to avoid a stale or miscopied digest being mistaken for a live check. Re-running Section 3 of the notebook against your own copy of the data will regenerate and print it directly.

runs.used_for: All numbers reported in the manuscript tables and figures unless otherwise noted.
Independent reproducibility check only (manuscript Section 5.10 and Section 7). Not the source of any headline number reported elsewhere in the manuscript.

stable_across_environments: sealed_test_auc (0.926 vs 0.930, both consistent with the training-partition nested-CV estimate)
dataset content and shape (SHA-256 verified identical)
sensitive_to_environment: imbalance_strategy_locked: near-exact tie (0.8994 vs 0.8995) flips winner between 'No resampling' and 'Class-weight (balanced)'; does not change the substantive conclusion that all four strategies are statistically indistinguishable on this cohort
mean_of_fold_vs_pooled_oof_disagreement: present in the primary run (motivating the parallel logistic-regression analysis, manuscript Section 5.12), essentially absent in the cross-check run
locked_threshold_youden_j: 0.377 vs 0.43 — the largest and most visible of the environment-sensitive values
comparison_summary.root_cause: Multi-threaded gradient-boosted tree construction is not guaranteed bit-for-bit deterministic across hardware, thread counts, and library versions even at a fixed random seed. Values already close to a tie in one environment (imbalance-strategy AUCs; the two nested-CV summary statistics) are the ones most likely to flip under this kind of floating-point perturbation; values with a wide margin (overall discrimination) are not.
comparison_summary.not_an_error: A reader reproducing this pipeline on different hardware should expect the same qualitative conclusions and similar headline AUC/sensitivity, but should not expect the exact threshold or strategy-comparison values to reproduce to three decimal places. See README.md Section 7 and manuscript Section 7 (Limitations) for the full discussion.
